title: ResultReference name field not validated against prior call method name
description: RFC 8620 §9: the ResultReference name field MUST equal the method name of the referenced call-id. resolve_args() checks only result_of (call-id) but never compares rr.name against the actual method name for that call-id in prior_responses. A client can pass any name and still get resolution. Low security impact (sandboxed), non-conformant with spec.
